messages:
maria: Quick proposal — add a minimal client-visible payload field + telemetry mapping to make routing reasons actionable in dashboards. Sketch below.

maria: Example response body:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{
  "error": {
    "code": "rate_limit",
    "subcode": "tenant_quota",
    "retryable": true,
    "retry_after": 30,
    "hint": "quota_remaining:0"
  }
}
```

kevin: I like explicit `retryable` flag. Question: do we leak `tenant_quota` internally? prefer short canonical subcodes not internal route names.

maria: Agreed. subcode should be a curated set (quota, burst, routing-overload, model-fallback). not kube/route names. we map internal route_reason -> subcode in infra and emit telemetry `route_reason` for ops only.

sam: For SDKs: when `retryable:true` do we auto-backoff or leave to client? current SDKs only backoff on 5xx+retry-after.

kevin: My vote: SDKs should do a conservative auto-retry for retryable:true but only with jittered exponential and capped attempts. docstring must call out idempotency.

jess: Console copy question — what badge text do we show? `Degraded` vs `Rate limited` vs `SoftFail`? Also users will see this in their tenant dashboard.

maria: Proposal: show two-tier badge: primary short label (Rate-limited / Degraded / Offline) and secondary cause (Quota / Region / ModelFallback) in tooltip. example: `Degraded — Quota` with a yellow badge.

jess: That reads well. Also add a "what to do" link in tooltip: `Reduce batch size` / `request higher tier` / `contact support` depending on subcode.

sam: Telemetry: ensure `route_reason` and `subcode` are both tags so we can pivot. Also emit `retryable` boolean and `retry_after_ms` metric.

maria: Implementation notes: router will map internal terminal reasons -> external subcode enum. rollout plan: start with 2-week shadow mode where we emit fields but don't surface to users.

kevin: Shadow mode good. Also add guardrail to avoid exposing PII in hints. aws-route/zone info should never be surfaced.

maria: Agree. Jess — can you draft the UI copy? I can open a PR to the router to add mapping table.

deploy-bot: deploy: routing-mapping-v1 succeeded in staging — 2026-03-21T15:02:10Z :rocket:

jess: Will do. I'll post drafts by EOD.

sam: One more: analytics team wants historical bucket for `degraded_by_quota` to trigger pricing workflows. make sure subcode is stable.

maria: Noted — will lock the enum and add migration notes.

kevin: SGTM. +1 to `retryable` in payload and shadow rollouts.

maria: Thanks all — I'll spin up RFC and link here shortly. :thumbsup:
